note: Batch 3 = three more exercises Aziz logs in Strong (confirmed names) plus 13 staples from the library. Same format and rules as batches 1 and 2 (primary red #d9392c, secondary amber #f0a030).

exercises.equipment: Seated pec deck: back pad, two vertical lever arms with elbow/forearm pads or handles at chest height, pivot above the head
exercises.technique: Back flat on the pad; forearms/handles at chest height; arms sweep together in front of the chest, then open until a stretch without the shoulders rolling forward.
exercises.source: Strong: Chest Fly, 97 workouts (Aziz confirmed: pec deck machine)

exercises.equipment: Single-arm cable curl facing away from a low pulley, one D-handle, cable behind the body
exercises.camera: side three-quarter view, from the working-arm side
exercises.technique: Stand facing away from the low pulley, arm behind the body; curl the D-handle forward and up without swinging the torso; lower under control to a full stretch behind you.
exercises.source: Strong: underarm curl (cable), 50 workouts (Aziz confirmed: single-arm Bayesian cable curl)

exercises.equipment: Flat plate-loaded chest press: lying on a flat bench, two lever arms with vertical (neutral) handles, plates on the lever ends
exercises.technique: Lie flat; grip the vertical handles at chest level; press up and slightly inward so the handles move toward the centre of the chest; lower with control.
exercises.source: Strong: Flat Bench Neutral Grip, 38 workouts (Aziz confirmed)

exercises.equipment: Barbell on the floor with plates, flat shoes
exercises.technique: Bar over mid-foot, flat back, hips and knees extend together, bar stays against the legs, lock out standing tall and lower the same path.

exercises.equipment: Standing with a barbell held at the thighs
exercises.technique: Soft knees, hips push back, back stays flat, bar slides down the thighs to just below the knee, squeeze the glutes to stand.

exercises.equipment: Barbell held with an overhand grip, torso hinged forward about 45 degrees
exercises.technique: Hinged torso stays still; pull the bar to the lower ribs; elbows close to the body; lower to straight arms.
Full hang with straight arms; pull until the chin passes the bar without swinging; lower to a full hang.

exercises.equipment: Parallel dip bars, bodyweight, torso leaning forward
exercises.technique: Lean forward, lower until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor, press back up without locking out hard.

exercises.equipment: Standing with a barbell racked at the shoulders
exercises.technique: Bar from the collarbone to above the head with the ribs down and the glutes tight; the bar passes close to the face.

exercises.equipment: Standing with a straight barbell, underhand grip
exercises.technique: Elbows pinned at the sides, curl the bar to the chest, lower fully without swinging.

exercises.equipment: Standing with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other
exercises.technique: Elbows at the sides, palms face each other throughout, curl up and lower with control.

exercises.equipment: Standing holding one dumbbell vertically at the chest
exercises.technique: Dumbbell at the chest, elbows inside the knees, squat to at least parallel with the chest tall, stand up.

exercises.equipment: Walking forward with a dumbbell in each hand
exercises.technique: Long step, rear knee drops toward the floor, front shin vertical, push through the front foot into the next step.

exercises.equipment: Upper back on a bench, barbell across the hips with a pad
exercises.technique: Shoulder blades on the bench, feet flat; drive the hips up until the torso is level with the thighs, chin tucked, lower under control.

exercises.equipment: Incline bench about 30 degrees with a barbell and plates
exercises.technique: Bar to the upper chest, forearms vertical at the bottom, press up and slightly back over the shoulders.

exercises.equipment: One hand and one knee on a flat bench, dumbbell in the other hand
exercises.technique: Flat back; pull the dumbbell to the hip with the elbow close to the body; lower to a full stretch.
